verses.original: וַיַּרְאֵ֗נִי אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֔וֹל עֹמֵ֕ד לִפְנֵ֖י מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֑ה וְהַשָּׂטָ֛ן עֹמֵ֥ד עַל־ יְמִינ֖וֹ לְשִׂטְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar·’ê·nî ’eṯ- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏō·wl ‘ō·mêḏ lip̄·nê mal·’aḵ Yah·weh wə·haś·śā·ṭān ‘ō·mêḏ ‘al- yə·mî·nōw lə·śiṭ·nōw
verses.literal: Then the angel showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD with Satan standing at his right hand to accuse him
verses.literalPt: E ELE mostrou-me o sumo sacerdote Josué, o qual estava diante do anjo do SENHOR, e Satanás estava à sua mão direita, para se lhe opor.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ הַשָּׂטָ֗ן יִגְעַ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה בְּךָ֙ הַשָּׂטָ֔ן וְיִגְעַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ בְּךָ֔ הַבֹּחֵ֖ר בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הֲל֧וֹא זֶ֦ה א֖וּד מֻצָּ֥ל מֵאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- haś·śā·ṭān yiḡ·‘ar Yah·weh bə·ḵā haś·śā·ṭān wə·yiḡ·‘ar Yah·weh bə·ḵā hab·bō·ḥêr bî·rū·šā·lim hă·lō·w zeh ’ūḏ muṣ·ṣāl mê·’êš
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Satan The LORD rebukes you Satan Indeed, the LORD who has chosen Jerusalem rebukes you Is not this man a firebrand snatched from the fire
verses.literalPt: Mas o SENHOR disse a Satanás: O SENHOR te repreenda, ó Satanás, sim, o SENHOR, que escolheu Jerusalém, te repreenda; não é este um tição tirado do fogo?

verses.original: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֕עַ הָיָ֥ה לָבֻ֖שׁ בְּגָדִ֣ים צוֹאִ֑ים וְעֹמֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י הַמַּלְאָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hō·wō·šu·a‘ hā·yāh lā·ḇuš bə·ḡā·ḏîm ṣō·w·’îm wə·‘ō·mêḏ lip̄·nê ham·mal·’āḵ
verses.literal: Now Joshua was dressed in filthy garments as he stood before the angel
verses.literalPt: Josué, vestido de vestes sujas, estava diante do anjo.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַן וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֶל־ הָעֹמְדִ֤ים לְפָנָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הָסִ֛ירוּ הַבְּגָדִ֥ים הַצֹּאִ֖ים מֵעָלָ֑יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו רְאֵ֨ה הֶעֱבַ֤רְתִּי מֵעָלֶ֙יךָ֙ עֲוֺנֶ֔ךָ וְהַלְבֵּ֥שׁ אֹתְךָ֖ מַחֲלָצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an way·yō·mer ’el- hā·‘ō·mə·ḏîm lə·p̄ā·nāw lê·mōr hā·sî·rū hab·bə·ḡā·ḏîm haṣ·ṣō·’îm mê·‘ā·lāw way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw rə·’êh he·‘ĕ·ḇar·tî mê·‘ā·le·ḵā ‘ă·wō·ne·ḵā wə·hal·bêš ’ō·ṯə·ḵā ma·ḥă·lā·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: So the angel said to those standing before him Take off his filthy clothes Then he said to Joshua See I have removed your iniquity and I will clothe you with splendid robes
verses.literalPt: Então respondeu, aos que estavam diante dele, dizendo: Tirai-lhe estas vestes sujas. E a Josué disse: Eis que tenho feito com que passe de ti a tua iniqüidade, e te vestirei de vestes finas.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר יָשִׂ֛ימוּ צָנִ֥יף טָה֖וֹר עַל־ רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיָּשִׂימוּ֩ הַצָּנִ֨יף הַטָּה֜וֹר עַל־ רֹאשׁ֗וֹ וַיַּלְבִּשֻׁ֙הוּ֙ בְּגָדִ֔ים וּמַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה עֹמֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar yā·śî·mū ṣā·nîp̄ ṭā·hō·wr ‘al- rō·šōw way·yā·śî·mū haṣ·ṣā·nîp̄ haṭ·ṭā·hō·wr ‘al- rō·šōw way·yal·bi·šu·hū bə·ḡā·ḏîm ū·mal·’aḵ Yah·weh ‘ō·mêḏ
verses.literal: Then I said Let them put a clean turban on his head So a clean turban was placed on his head and they clothed him . . . as the angel of the LORD stood by
verses.literalPt: E disse eu: Ponham-lhe uma mitra limpa sobre a sua cabeça. E puseram uma mitra limpa sobre a sua cabeça, e vestiram-no das roupas; e o anjo do SENHOR estava em pé.

verses.literal: Then the angel of the LORD gave this charge to Joshua . . .
verses.literalPt: E o anjo do SENHOR protestou a Josué, dizendo:

verses.original: כֹּה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אִם־ בִּדְרָכַ֤י תֵּלֵךְ֙ וְאִ֣ם אֶת־ מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֣י תִשְׁמֹ֔ר וְגַם־ אַתָּה֙ תָּדִ֣ין אֶת־ בֵּיתִ֔י וְגַ֖ם תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר אֶת־ חֲצֵרָ֑י וְנָתַתִּ֤י לְךָ֙ מַהְלְכִ֔ים בֵּ֥ין הָעֹמְדִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’im- biḏ·rā·ḵay tê·lêḵ wə·’im ’eṯ- miš·mar·tî ṯiš·mōr wə·ḡam- ’at·tāh tā·ḏîn ’eṯ- bê·ṯî wə·ḡam tiš·mōr ’eṯ- ḥă·ṣê·rāy wə·nā·ṯat·tî lə·ḵā mah·lə·ḵîm bên hā·‘ō·mə·ḏîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts says If you walk . . . in My ways and keep My instructions then you will govern My house and will also have charge of My courts and I will give you a place among these who are standing here
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos: Se andares nos meus caminhos, e se observares a minha ordenança, também tu julgarás a minha casa, e também guardarás os meus átrios, e te darei livre acesso entre os que estão aqui.

verses.original: שְֽׁמַֽע־ נָ֞א יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ׀ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֗וֹל אַתָּה֙ וְרֵעֶ֙יךָ֙ הַיֹּשְׁבִ֣ים לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּֽי־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י מוֹפֵ֖ת הֵ֑מָּה כִּֽי־ הִנְנִ֥י מֵבִ֛יא אֶת־ עַבְדִּ֖י צֶֽמַח׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘- nā yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏō·wl ’at·tāh wə·rê·‘e·ḵā hay·yō·šə·ḇîm lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā kî- ’an·šê mō·w·p̄êṯ hêm·māh kî- hin·nî mê·ḇî ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·dî ṣe·maḥ
verses.literal: Hear now O high priest Joshua you and your companions seated before you who are indeed . . . a sign . . . For behold I am going to bring My servant the Branch
verses.literalPt: Ouve, pois, Josué, sumo sacerdote, tu e os teus companheiros que se assentam diante de ti, porque são homens portentosos; eis que eu farei vir o meu servo, o RENOVO.

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ הִנֵּ֣ה הָאֶ֗בֶן אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָתַ֙תִּי֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ עַל־ אֶ֥בֶן אַחַ֖ת שִׁבְעָ֣ה עֵינָ֑יִם הִנְנִ֧י מְפַתֵּ֣חַ פִּתֻּחָ֗הּ נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּמַשְׁתִּ֛י אֶת־ עֲוֺ֥ן הָאָֽרֶץ־ הַהִ֖יא בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nêh hā·’e·ḇen ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lip̄·nê yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ‘al- ’e·ḇen ’a·ḥaṯ šiḇ·‘āh ‘ê·nā·yim hin·nî mə·p̄at·tê·aḥ pit·tu·ḥāh nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ū·maš·tî ’eṯ- ‘ă·wōn hā·’ā·reṣ- ha·hî bə·yō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: See the stone I have set before Joshua on that one stone are seven eyes Behold I will engrave on it an inscription declares the LORD of Hosts and I will remove the iniquity of this land in a single day
verses.literalPt: Porque eis aqui a pedra que pus diante de Josué; sobre esta pedra única estão sete olhos; eis que eu esculpirei a sua escultura, diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, e tirarei a iniqüidade desta terra num só dia.

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת תִּקְרְא֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ לְרֵעֵ֑הוּ אֶל־ תַּ֥חַת גֶּ֖פֶן וְאֶל־ תַּ֥חַת תְּאֵנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ tiq·rə·’ū ’îš lə·rê·‘ê·hū ’el- ta·ḥaṯ ge·p̄en wə·’el- ta·ḥaṯ tə·’ê·nāh
verses.literal: On that day declares the LORD of Hosts you will each invite . . . your neighbor to sit under your own vine and fig tree
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, cada um de vós convidará o seu próximo para debaixo da videira e para debaixo da figueira.
